title: Running Commentary on Torah 27 — Retzitza d'Meis (Expanded)
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 27 — רציצא דמית (מורחב)
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. T27 is the *expanded* unfolding of the same Bechoros 8b ma'amar that opens T26 — the Athenian-tzaddik-in-tefillah riddle now opened into a much larger world-redemption architecture: shalom in the dor → tikkun habris → 13 middos → hadras panim → kol rinah → b'inyenei nefesh u-b'inyenei or ha-olam.
